description: This file defines a Playwright test component class for interacting with the 'Flag Post Confirmation' dialog in the Mattermost web application, including methods for interacting with UI elements and verifying dialog states.

classes.name: FlagPostConfirmationDialog
classes.description: A class representing the flag post confirmation dialog in the Mattermost UI, providing methods to interact with and verify the dialog's elements.

methods.name: fillFlagComment
methods.description: Fills the flag comment input with the provided comment.

methods.name: selectFlagReason
methods.description: Selects a reason from the flag reason dropdown.

methods.name: toBeVisible
methods.description: Asserts that the dialog and key elements are visible.

methods.name: toContainPostText
methods.description: Verifies that the post text contains the specified message.

methods.name: notToBeVisible
methods.description: Asserts that the dialog and key elements are not visible.

methods.name: cannotFlagAlreadyFlaggedPostToBeVisible
methods.description: Verifies that the error message for already flagged post is visible.

methods.name: requireCommentsForFlaggingPost
methods.description: Verifies that the error message for missing comments is visible.

methods.name: cannotFlagPreviouslyRetainedPostToBeVisible
methods.description: Verifies that the error message for previously retained post is visible.
